provenance.paper_title: SE-GA: Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution for GUI Agents

representation_paths.memory_component: episodic, semantic, and experiential GUI memory

evidence.paraphrase: TTME retrieves hierarchical episodic, semantic, and experiential memory at inference.

representation_paths.memory_component: LoRA-adapted GUI policy conditioned on accumulated interaction experience

evidence.paraphrase: MASE uses accumulated GUI interaction experience to adapt the agent policy with LoRA, internalizing reusable experience in parameters.
During operation, SE-GA applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to episodic, semantic, and experiential GUI memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, SE-GA applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to episodic, semantic, and experiential GUI memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (episodic, semantic, and experiential GUI memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
